STALE-AFTER-#165: compare_aw49_reference.py now grades the SHARED #110 definition (float32 full scale 1.0), so every value in these six records is pre-#110 and must not be compared with #110 values. They are NOT re-graded here for two separate reasons, both recorded: (a) five of the six cases have no committed aw49 taps .npz (only temple__seq-notes-coverage-v1 does), so they cannot run on any host without the DR-0006 oracle renders; (b) ALL SIX -- including the runnable one -- carry model_frozen_revision 1901510e..., while the committed model's frozen_revision() is 569bff13... (the docs/byte-frozen-sources.json pin), so re-emitting one would also republish a model-revision change that is NOT #165's. The leaf must be republished as one set on the oracle host: routed to #270
